capabilities: calculate intrinsic value with WACC, DCF, Graham, Ten Cap, DDM, and Payback Time methods
fetch live prices by ticker from Yahoo Finance
project bull/base/bear growth scenarios with sensitivity grids
save valuations and timestamped price/fair-value history as per-ticker Markdown notes
chart margin of safety and fair value versus price over time
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the built-in help opens with a disclaimer that it is a calculator, not investing advice. Version 2.0 changed the storage format and older versions cannot read the new notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for financial calculation, so investors must run valuations in spreadsheets or other apps and keep results outside their vault.

relations.evidence: Live price lookup by ticker via Yahoo Finance
dividends per share can be fetched from SEC EDGAR

summary: Stock valuation calculator that computes intrinsic value via WACC, DCF, Graham, Ten Cap, and DDM, and stores valuations and history as vault notes.
